jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
Empresa internacional IT busca experto en UX, con solida experiencia en Angular o React como front-end.

Empresa muy flexible, enfocada a utilizar siempre las best practices (últimas tecnologías para desarrollar, metodología Scrum, clean code, SOLID, TDD, BDD)

Responsabilidades
• Buscamos una persona más enfocada al desarrollo de esa capa visual, más en lado de la maquetación y menos en el lado del diseño.
• Liderar el proceso de diseño centrado en el usuario, desde la investigación inicial hasta la implementación, utilizando metodologías como Design Thinking y User Research para comprender las necesidades y comportamientos de los usuarios.
• Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con equipos de desarrollo y negocio para traducir los requisitos comerciales y técnicos en soluciones de UX efectivas y escalables.
• Diseñar flujos de usuario, wireframes y prototipos interactivos que reflejen las mejores prácticas de diseño centrado en el usuario y la experiencia agile.
• Dirigir pruebas de... usabilidad y análisis heurístico para identificar áreas de mejora en la experiencia del usuario y proponer soluciones efectivas.
• Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo en la implementación de soluciones de UX, asegurando una integración fluida y eficiente.
• Promover una cultura centrada en el usuario dentro de la organización, educando a equipos técnicos y de negocio sobre la importancia de la experiencia del usuario.
• Mantenerse al tanto de las tendencias y mejores prácticas en diseño de UX y tecnología, y aplicarlas de manera efectiva en los proyectos.
• Mentorizar a otros miembros del equipo de diseño y desarrollo en metodologías de UX y colaborar en su desarrollo profesional.

Requisitos

Angular como lenguaje de programación

Separación de la capa de negocio de la de usuario.

La capa de usuario sería a montar desde 0, pero siguiendo patrones definidos por la compañía en cuestión.

📍 Ubicación: 3 días en oficinas de Madrid (Chamartin)

💙 Al sumarte a la familia de Capitole tendrás:

• Presupuesto de 1.200€ en formación individual para que lo utilices en lo que tú quieras (eventos tecnológicos, libros, formaciones, certificaciones etc.).

• Seguimiento con tu equipo todos los meses para tener un continuo feedback.

• Seguro médico privado pagado íntegramente por Capitole

• Retribución flexible (tickets restaurante, transporte y/o guardería).

• Andjoy (Gymforless)

• Descuentos en grandes marcas para emplead@s (Club Capitole)

Para que conozcas a toda la familia:

• Team Buildings cada dos meses. ¡No te puedes perder la fiesta de verano o la cena de Navidad!

• Equipo de fútbol patrocinado por Capitole.

• Comunidades tecnológicas para que compartas tus conocimientos e ideas con los demás equipos. ¡¡¡Compartir el conocimiento interno es fundamental!!!

• ¡Por último y no menos importante un EQUIPAZO!

¿Aún no nos conoces? ¡¡Descúbrenos!! https://capitole-consulting.com/

Mira lo que opinan de nosotros 👀 https://www.glassdoor.es/Opiniones/Capitole-Consulting-Opiniones-E2060890.htm

No dudes en enviarnos tu perfil, ¡estamos deseando conocerte

jobs_results.title: Front End Developer (m/f/d)
jobs_results.description:
Job Location: Madrid, remote in Spain.

What do we do: We create solutions that have the power to change the supply chain and logistics world. The world of smart logistics and mobility is transforming our lives with connected vehicles, digitalization of supply chain processes, and smart cities, making our lives as consumers and workers easier. We are at the driving seat of the digital transformation of this industry by bringing location-based, connected vehicle, and operational software solutions together in serving major enterprise, multinational company, government, and public sector customers. Millions of daily transactions are processed by our systems, helping improve overall supply chain efficiency, increase profitability, protect our environment by saving fuel and creating safety programs for diverse industries.

About the team:

You will participate in agile development lifecycles from sprint planning to retrospective. You will be part of a Squad, a cross-functional, autonomous... team that focuses on our core web portal using React.js and microservices technology, in the cloud environment (Azure). The solution is acting as the Astrata’s face for our customers and partners, being core for the business.

Our team consists of developers from diverse backgrounds, who are willing to work together and share their knowledge. We are looking for an analytical person, a true team player who is willing to learn but also not afraid to challenge, share ideas and adapt solutions.

Your skills and experience:

We are looking for multiple developers at different stages of their career, starting from 3 years of experience.

Our work language is English so you should be able to speak and understand English well.

You should have demonstrable experience in:

• React.js, TypeScript, HTML5 and CSS

• UI/UX Experience

• It would be a great plus if you have prior experience in writing unit tests and know how to test various aspects of our stack

What do we offer?

We offer you a full-time position in an informal and professional working environment with room for personal development. We have a competitive compensation package. We value a good balance of work and private life. For this reason we offer a summer schedule and flexibility with working hours.

We do not offer visa support or relocation package for this role. Applicants should be eligible to work in Spain.

Interested?

Apply by clicking the apply button, fill in the online form, and attach your CV.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.

A check of references will be a part of the selection process.

Here’s what happens after you send your application

You will receive an email confirming our HR department has received your application. An update will follow as to what the next stage will be for you

jobs_results.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
We are looking from strong background in UI Development with some exposure in IOS/Android

Base location could be Madrid, Toronto or UK.

About the Job

Engineers at BXB Digital work on next generation digital supply chain platform (IoT-enabled supply chain). As a member of a creative, motivated, and talented team, you develop new products that are used by internal and external operations team. We need our engineers to be versatile and passionate to take on new problems as we continue to push forward in converting the supply chain to digital supply chain. If you get excited about building new things and working across disciplines, then our team might be your next career step.

As a Mobile developer, you will play a crucial role in the creation and maintenance of mobile applications that run seamlessly on multiple platforms. You will work closely with our application and platform development teams, and our UX design team to deliver high-quality, user-friendly apps that provide an... outstanding user experience. The work is challenging, fast-paced, and always changing. You have demonstrated analytical skills, an unwavering commitment to quality, a collaborative work ethic, and cutting-edge coding skills.

Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.
• 4 years of coding experience in one or more of the listed languages: Java/Kotlin, Objective C/Swift, JavaScript, Typescript, CSS, HTML
• Experience with JavaScript frameworks (Angular or React) and CSS pre-processing frameworks (Sass or Less).
• Proven experience in mobile app development, specifically using Cordova.
• Understanding of cross-platform development challenges and solutions.
• Experience with version control systems, particularly Git.
• Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.

Responsibilities
• App Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain hybrid mobile applications using Cordova that are compatible with both Android and iOS platforms.
• Code Optimization: Optimize application performance for a smooth user experience and ensure responsiveness.
• User Interface (UI/UX): Collaborate with designers to implement intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces.
• Plugin Integration: Integrate and customize Cordova plugins to add functionality and features to the mobile apps.
• Cross-Platform Compatibility: Ensure that the apps function seamlessly on various devices and screen sizes.
• Version Control: Manage code repositories and version control systems, such as Git.
• Testing and Debugging: Perform thorough testing and debugging to identify and resolve issues.
• Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor app performance, conduct regular assessments, and implement improvements.
• Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive code documentation.
• Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and QA engineers, to deliver high-quality applications on time

jobs_results.title: Senior Angular Frontend
jobs_results.description:
📢 Business Insights es una empresa de desarrollo de software personalizado para empresas. Estamos viviendo una etapa de crecimiento y queremos incorporar al equipo la figura de un Frontend Developer Angular para trabajar en Madrid. jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer - Development (Openbank)
jobs_results.description:
Country: Spain

We are the 100% digital bank of the Santander Group and we are currently undergoing a technological transformation and international expansion. In 2016 the re-launch of the Bank began and since then we have been in continuous expansion and growth, especially in our technological side. We work in a start-up format, using agile methodologies to take our clients' experience to the next level. In 2019 we launched the Bank in the Netherlands, Germany and Portugal and recently following also the launch in Argentina with others to follow. Our culture makes us different; social and diversity clubs are part of our essence and allow us to live our culture every day. We are a flexible and fast adapting team that currently works remotely most of the time using all kinds of communication tools, we haven´t noticed the change!

Mission:

We’re building an innovative, cutting-edge, banking platform designed for seamless international expansion, prioritizing scalability, extension, and... accessibility. Our architectural foundation embraces Domain-Driven Design, Ports & Adapters pattern, and other clean architecture concepts meticulously tailored to meet our unique requirements. Join us in shaping the future of frontend development within this visionary project!

Responsibilities:
• As a member of the Openbank Development team, you will contribute to web development with React, Typescript, Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
• Given that a large part of our product is based on code libraries that will be consumed by multiple teams, a strong emphasis is placed on testing. Your role includes crafting a robust test suite using Jest and react-testing-library.
• Actively contribute to the enhancement and definition of our front-end architecture, rooted in clean architecture principles, SOLID, hexagonal architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
• Collaborating in the improvement of our shared libraries, fostering a culture that welcomes individual contributions from all engineering team members, regardless of seniority!
• Engage in code reviews, pair programming sessions, and actively contribute to reinforcing common best practices to maintain code quality and consistency.
• Approach tasks with a results-oriented mindset, taking ownership of your deliveries and encouraging strong communication and collaboration with team members and stakeholders. We’re all committed to promote and foster a healthy and collaborative culture!

What are we looking for in this position?
• 3+ years of hands-on experience in Javascript.
• 1+ years of proficient experience with Typescript, expertise in generics, type narrowing, and other advanced topics will be valued.
• A minimum of 2 years of focused experience with ReactJS frameworks last versions, demonstrating a deep understanding of compound components and associated concepts.
• Proven track record in writing unit tests using Jest and react-testing-library, or similar testing frameworks.
• Proficiency in CSS, with a preference for experience with Sass or Less preprocessors or CSS-in-JS solutions.
• Knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in the context of Javascript.
• Familiarity with SOLID principles, clean architecture concepts, and a profound understanding of general software design patterns, including where and why to apply them.
• Nice to have: understanding of hexagonal (ports & adapters) architecture and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
• Good communication skills both in English and Spanish at a B2-C1 level.

What do we offer?
• Immediate incorporation to a dynamic and agile company with a growing and expanding project.
• Working in a start-up environment with the support of Grupo Santander.
• Competitive remuneration and attractive benefits package.
• Possibility of growth within the company and the Group.
• Collaboration in international projects and possibility of contact with different countries.
• Excellent work environment, social clubs and frequent events

Would you like to grow with us? Join our team!

Openbank is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered as equal without paying attention to gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, age, political orientation, union membership nor disability status.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

If you´re not currently living in Madrid, Bilbao or Valencia and you are open to relocate, we would still love to consider your application.

The personal data you provide as well as any data generated during the selection process are confidential and will be processed by Open Bank, S.A./ Open Digital Services, S.L. with registered office at Plaza de Santa Bárbara 2, 28004 (Madrid), for the sole purpose of managing your participation in the selection processes and, where appropriate, to formalise your recruitment. 

For further information about your rights and data protection, please read the ODS/Openbank Privacy Policy applicable to this type of data processing here. [URL]

UKR2022

OBTECH22

OBDEV22

#OPENBANK

jobs_results.title: Frontend Developer
jobs_results.description:
"I built my talents on the shoulders of someone else’s talent."

Michael Jordan

At Naiz Fit, we are excited to announce an incredible opportunity to join our team as a Senior Backend Developer. You will collaborate closely with the Technology team and report directly to the CTO.

We're looking for a talented, dedicated, and passionate software engineer to play a leading role in bringing our tools and infrastructure to the next level, contributing to the success and growth of the organization by effectively managing and advancing the technology aspects of the business.

We are looking for adventurers like you who want to be part of our expansion globally and make a lasting impact in the fashion industry.

Join the team and keep rocking it Naiz Style.
• What is Naiz Fit?

At the beginning of every story there is a once upon a time, some complicit glances and the must-have butterflies in your stomach, and to begin our story we would love to get you to know us a bit better.

The once... upon a time starts with a question: which is your size? We bet you had to answer that (and had no idea how to😉) at least once in your life while buying a new outfit.

That was our trigger when, 5 years ago, we were born to help the fashion industry to solve this question.

We had complicit glances with the first fashion brands which made us deeply understand the problem to build a solution for all of us, because brands and fashion lovers are in the same game. #YourBodyYourSize.

The magic (and butterflies) came when we unified the digital world with its data, and the creative art of fashion by trying the collections of the brands who want to solve their sizing issues on real people with different body types.

Because fashion is way more than a bunch of numbers.

We are partners in crime with brands to create an industry where all body types will find their perfect fit.

Our story started as a digital solution for ecommerce to assist buyers while choosing sizes.

That was the beginning of an adventure that brought us to today, now we are part of MySize Inc group, a Nasdaq listed company, and we are helping fashion brands with solutions for ecommerce, retail and product departments to address size&fit issues with ad hoc solutions for every step of the value chain.
• Our clients

At Naiz Fit, our clients are the heart of our focus. We are committed to delivering exceptional service tailored to their unique needs. To give you a better idea, here are a few examples of the variety of clients we work with.

Key Responsibilities:

We are looking for a Front-End Web Developer who is motivated to combine the art of design with the art of programming.

Responsibilities will include translation of the UI/UX design wireframes to actual code that will produce visual elements of the application.

You will work with the UI/UX designer and bridge the gap between graphical design and technical implementation, taking an active role on both sides and defining how the application looks as well as how it works.

You will be responsible for:
• Build reusable code and libraries for future use.
• Optimize application for maximum speed and scalabilityDevelop new user-facing features with and without design
• Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
• Assure that all user input is validated before submitting to back-end
• Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders

Skills and qualifications:
• Proficient in web markup languages, including HTML5 and CSS3.
• Familiarity with server-side CSS pre-processing platforms like LESS and SASS.
• Strong knowledge of advanced JavaScript libraries and frameworks such as React
• Proficiency in TypeScript Technology for efficient and robust software development, ensuring high-quality code and seamless project execution.
• Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team.
• Proficient with code versioning tools like Github.
• Experience with the Agile Framework, promoting teamwork, scalability, and stability.
• Proactive mindset and a strong sense of ownership towards code.
• Analytical thinking and a willingness to tackle challenging problems independently.
• Enthusiasm for continuous learning and keeping pace with advancements in technology.
• Highly communicative and able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Strong communication skills in both English and Spanish.

The selection process:
• Upon successfully passing our screening process, you'll proceed to:
• A first interview with the Head of People.
• A second interview with the CTO and Head of People.
• If you progress further, you'll be invited to take tests assessing your problem-solving skills.
• Successful candidates will then participate in a final Cultural interview.
• We welcome applications in both Spanish and English.

Why would you love to join us?

🌍 Remote friendly culture. We're 100% remote . We have offices in San Sebastián, Madrid and Barcelona and Coruña.

🕛Flexible schedules that work with your life. Freedom environment, which entails responsibility

🖖 Career development, encompassing personalized training programs, regular performance reviews and access to professional development resources.

⚡ A key position in the company where you can see your impact on the business from the very beginning.

👫 We cultivate a positive work Culture at supports personal and professional growth, and we make sure to have a great time together at our quarterly work retreats—all expenses covered by the company.

🟠 Our Values

Ask for forgiveness, not permission

Embrace Uniqueness

Team of Minions

Enjoy the ride
• If you are excited about everything that you have just read... Join us!------------

To prove our culture, we leave you here a talk given by our CEO, Borja Cembrero, which we believe represents our culture very well.
• We have crossed out the words artificial intelligence because we are tired of so much big words in the tech world. We solve a problem, which is THE important thing. But if you join us, we'll explain you all the details about how we solve it

jobs_results.title: Frontend Software Engineer, React-TypeScript
jobs_results.description:
Frontend Software Engineer, React-TypeScript

At DataBeacon our mission is to revolutionize the aviation industry using a modern technology stack, open source technologies and lean architectures.

Our first product is SimpliFID, an Aerodrome Flight Information Service (AFIS) that covers most functionalities of a radar system at a fraction of the costs. Built in Rust, Python and TypeScript, it sources data from ADB-S and Mode-S Secondary Surveillance Radar (SSR) systems over Asterix CAT021 Surveillance Data Exchange protocol and delivers it to the user with near zero-latency. Our main focus is on scalability, security and the development and discovery of additional products in the real-time data services for aviation space.

In anticipation to the exciting challenges ahead, we look forward to extend our engineering team with an exceptional TypeScript and React Software Engineer.

What would you do:
• develop, maintain and improve DataBeacon’s frontend applications,
• work with a small... and highly motivated, skilled team of engineers,
• participate in the company technical decisions and roadmap,
• space to experiment and try-out new exciting technologies,
• have minimal administrative overhead and the possibility to create a real impact,
• submit your first patch in less than a week and the first feature in a month,

You must have:
• at least 3+ of relevant professional experience building reliable software applications,
• mastery of TypeScript, React and a client state management library, eg. Redux,
• have a good command of English and good communication skills,
• be located in Madrid or surroundings.

Nice to have:
• professional experience using MapBox or MapLibre,
• experience using Web Sockets and/or Server Side Events,
• motivation for learning Rust and Web Assembly,
• familiarity with containerized distributed applications deployed in AWS,
• experience building critical software applications in highly regulated sectors,
• affinity for aviation in general.

What we offer:
• a total of 25 vacation days, including Christmas' and New Year’s eves,
• hybrid and work-from-home policies tailored to your needs,
• a beautiful office in the center of Madrid, near Alonso Martinez,
• yearly budget for continuous learning, conferences, books, courses,
• a fairly generous compensation, reviewed yearly, and a personal growth plan.

If this position and our mission resonates with you, we would be excited to hear from you
